title: Telefónica / O2
lede: Led UX and product design across 5 global locations, building eHealth products that reduced chronic disease mortality and hospital readmissions.
role: UX Lead & Head of Product & Service Design

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Led UX, product and service design teams across 5 global locations (10–17 people), building eHealth, cloud and data privacy products at Telefonica worldwide.

sections.title: Key work
sections.body:
• Led design of a chronic disease management system (COPD, heart failure) for patients, nurses and clinicians on tablet, web and mobile — 48% mortality rate decrease and 63% decrease in readmission across UK, Brazil and Spain
  • Created a service using location patterns to detect epidemic sources faster, predict spread and follow up with education — in collaboration with the WHO, Unicef and Harvard
  • Created a voice analysis service using a standard telephone line to detect and monitor Parkinson's disease with 78% precision
  • Healthcare educational services via SMS for the general population and mothers-to-be in Brazil
  • Teledermatology service with Hospital del Mar in Barcelona
  • Led cross-disciplinary teams creating new data security and privacy products — 20+ MVPs, 5 successfully launched

sections.title: Key outcomes
sections.body:
• 48% decrease in mortality rate (chronic disease)
  • 63% decrease in hospital readmission
  • 20+ MVPs created, 5 launched
  • 78% precision in Parkinson's detection
